customer_name: Beijing Internet of Vehicles Technology Development Co., Ltd. (北京车网科技发展有限公司)
business_problem: Beijing's high-level autonomous-driving demonstration zone needed a scalable way to turn road-side sensing, traffic operations, and model development into a shared operating environment instead of a collection of disconnected pilot projects.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud helped Beijing E-Town's vehicle-road-cloud operator turn the autonomous-driving demonstration zone into a data-rich operating platform. Across versions 1.0 to 3.0 of the project, Baidu participated in building standard smart intersections, cloud-control infrastructure, and a one-stop model-service environment that can ingest point-cloud, visual, and text data for autonomous-driving and traffic scenarios. The architecture links road-side sensing, data access, data mining, labeling, training, evaluation, and deployment so developers can use real traffic data instead of synthetic pilot samples. It also exposes practical operations benefits: road-side infrastructure is standardized through 'many poles in one, many sensors in one, many boxes in one' intersection design, while traffic-control models optimize queues and signal timing on live roads. In effect, the zone is both an urban operating system for connected roads and a model-development environment for autonomous-driving innovation.

solution_components.name: Cloud Control Platform
solution_components.role: Coordinates data and operations for smart roads, connected vehicles, and autonomous-driving supervision.

solution_components.name: Vehicle-Road-Cloud Integrated Infrastructure
solution_components.role: Provides the road-side sensing and communications fabric that connects the urban testbed.

solution_components.name: Traffic Industry Large Model
solution_components.role: Uses multimodal traffic data to support signal optimization and future intelligent transportation applications.

solution_components.name: One-stop Model Service Platform
solution_components.role: Supports data access, mining, labeling, training, evaluation, deployment, and hosted training for developers.

data_flow: Road-side devices collect point-cloud, visual, and traffic-operation data, which is ingested into the cloud-control and model-service platforms for labeling, mining, training, and evaluation. The resulting models feed both autonomous-driving development and traffic-control operations such as signal optimization, queue management, and scenario simulation across the demonstration zone.
business_outcome: Beijing E-Town created a shared infrastructure and model platform for connected-road operations and autonomous-driving development, reducing deployment cost while improving traffic performance and opening high-value real-world data to the ecosystem.
metrics: Version 2.0 covers 301 smart intersections and 750 kilometers of two-way urban roads.
Road-side construction cost fell more than 40%.
Average vehicle delay at adaptive intersections fell 30.48%.
architecture_clues: The same environment is used for city operations, developer data access, and large-model training instead of separate pilot systems.
The standardized intersection design merges multiple poles, sensors, and boxes into unified roadside infrastructure.
Real traffic data and AIGC-generated samples are both used to create training and testing datasets for long-tail cases.
evidence_quotes: Baidu has participated in Beijing's autonomous-driving demonstration zone from version 1.0 through 3.0 (original: 2020年10月至今，陆续参与北京高级别自动驾驶示范区1.0、2.0至3.0建设).
Version 2.0 completed 301 standard smart intersections and 750 kilometers of two-way road coverage (original: 完成301个智能网联标准路口建设，双向750公里城市道路实现车路云一体化功能覆盖).
The zone is building a traffic industry large model and one-stop model service platform across point-cloud, vision, and text data (original: 打造多模态多场景多任务的预训练交通行业大模型…建设一站式模型服务平台).
Standardized intelligent-roadside design reduced construction cost by more than 40% and cut average intersection delay by 30.48% (original: 路侧建设成本较最初下降40%以上…单点自适应路口车均延误率下降达30.48%).
